component: Calendar list ordering across cache and provider replacement

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Initial list construction sorts calendars and calls addCalendarItem without its new flag. Registration events pass true and may restore initialSortOrderPos. Cache replacement records the old slot, and provider replacement first orders calendars by the saved list so reinsertion does not use cache order. BaseClass treats the hint as transient and its property writer skips persistence for that name. The browser tests assert list order and stored order for synthetic cache/provider replacements; fresh-window stale-hint behavior and live accessibility remain untested here.
title: Calendar row position hints apply to registration events, not initial list construction
